topic.title: Where Your Money Goes When You Swipe
topic.hook: The invisible chain taking a cut
topic.payoff: The invisible chain taking a cut

copy.title: EVERY SWIPE HAS A SILENT PARTNER

steps.rule: Clock the moment the card leaves your hand
steps.why: the transaction starts a chain before the merchant sees a cent.

steps.rule: Count every hand between you and the seller
steps.why: each layer in the chain is a toll booth with a fixed percentage.

steps.rule: Multiply that percentage by your annual spend
steps.why: two percent on twelve thousand dollars is two hundred and forty dollars redirected, invisibly, every year.

steps.rule: Trace who built each layer and why
steps.why: every cut was engineered by a party that profits more when you spend more.

steps.rule: Name the system running your spending before you swipe again
steps.why: a mechanism you can see cannot exploit the part of you that never looked.

copy.kicker: The chain runs whether you watch it or not
copy.thumb_scene: Wick stands upright on a plain white studio background, one arm extended forward holding a single payment card at eye level, a long paper receipt unrolling from his other hand down to the floor, his eyes fixed on the card with calm focus.
copy.send_to: the friend who tracks income but never tracks where it exits
